ucr_afford.title: UCR Admissions - How to make UCR affordable (international)

test_policy.notes: UC campuses will not consider SAT/ACT in admissions or scholarships.

requirements.notes: Fee is $95 for international applicants (UC page); fee waivers limited to US citizens, permanent residents and AB540-eligible applicants. Minimum nonresident high-school GPA is 3.4 per UCR.

deadlines.label: UC filing period closes
deadlines.notes: Filing period Oct 1 - Nov 30, 2026. No early plans. Decisions are released across March 1-31, 2027 (no campus-specific date published).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if all secondary school was in a country where English is not the language of instruction. Alternatives accepted by UC: AP English Language or Literature 3-5, IB English A SL 6-7 / HL 5-7, ACT English Language Arts 24+, SAT Writing and Language 31+, or a C or better in a UC-transferable college English composition course. Exam must be taken by December of the final year. Individual campuses may set higher minimums.

english.notes: IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted

aid.notes: International first-years are automatically considered for the Achievement Scholarship for Nonresident Students: up to $89,100 over four years, renewable with a 3.0 GPA each quarter. UCR's international pages do not describe need-based aid for international students, so no aid policy is recorded.

sat.note: UCR lists 'TOEFL / AP / SAT: 004839' (entered as 4839 here). UC does not consider SAT/ACT in admissions.

act.note: UC does not consider SAT/ACT in admissions.

toefl.note: UC says to self-report scores in the application and send official scores only to the campus where you enroll.
